generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

The bidder shall have Tested / Calibrated the Numerical relays of ABB / Alstom / Schneider / GE / SIEMENS make used for Generator protection / Power Transformer protection in any power utilities( Government / semi-Government / public sector / private organization). As a proof of this, bidder shall upload copy of Job order / Work Order for having value not less than Rs 1.96 Lakhs (exclusive of GST) in a single Work order in any one of the preceding five financial Years (2021-22 to 2025-26). Work order value for previous years will be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which tender is invited.
The Bidder shall be a CLASS-I electrical license holder. As a proof of this relevant documents shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- CLASS-I Electrical Licence issued by Electrical Inspectorate

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have achieved average annual financial turnover of Rs 3.91 Lakhs in any two of the preceding five financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26). The bidder shall furnish the Profit and loss account statement duly certified by chartered accountant as a documentary proof. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to present price level of the financial year in which tender is invited.
